versions.subject: blackbyte rules
versions.detection:
image:
    Image|contains: '\schtasks.exe'
selection_base:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'wscript'
        - 'vbscript'
        - 'cscript'
        - 'wmic '
        - 'wmic.exe'
        - 'regsvr32.exe'
        - 'powershell'
        - '\AppData\'
selection_content2:
    CommandLine|contains: 'once'
selection_content3:
    CommandLine|contains: '00:00'
bad_name:
    CommandLine|contains: 'Joke'
condition: image and selection_base and (1 of selection* or bad_name)
versions.spl: Image="*\\schtasks.exe*" CommandLine IN ("*wscript*", "*vbscript*", "*cscript*", "*wmic *", "*wmic.exe*", "*regsvr32.exe*", "*powershell*", "*\\AppData\\*") CommandLine IN ("*wscript*", "*vbscript*", "*cscript*", "*wmic *", "*wmic.exe*", "*regsvr32.exe*", "*powershell*", "*\\AppData\\*") OR CommandLine="*once*" OR CommandLine="*00:00*" OR CommandLine="*Joke*"
